<!--
PR 标题必须使用 Conventional Commit 格式：<type>(<scope>): <中文摘要>，scope 可省略。
常用 type：feat、fix、refactor、chore、docs、test、perf。
示例：fix(web): 修复普通用例页首屏媒体布局
创建 PR 时请单独核对标题；GitHub 不会用正文模板自动填写标题。
-->

## Why / 变更原因

<!-- Explain why this change is needed. Link related issues when applicable. -->

## What / 变更内容

<!-- Summarize the proposed changes. -->

## Scope / 影响范围

<!-- List affected apps, packages, APIs, users, or state that the change is isolated. -->

## Validation / 验证结果

<!-- List each command or manual check and its result. Explain anything not run. -->

## Risks & Rollback / 风险与回滚

<!-- Describe known risks and how to roll back, or explain why there are none. -->
